bio: Treat yourself to Afternoon Tea at Sawrey House, a beautiful family run hotel in the picturesque Lake District. Guests can indulge in a range of delightful sweet and savoury treats at this wonderful country house that was once a favourite retreat for the famous Beatrix Potter.  Afternoon Tea is served in their stylish restaurant, where guests can relax and unwind in the welcoming surroundings of this humble hideaway set in stunning Ambleside.  Their menu is a quintessential interpretation of the great British tradition, featuring a selection of sandwiches, scones with preserves and a sumptuous range of tasty sweets. Throughout the year, they run seasonal editions of their Afternoon Tea menu  Sawrey House is the perfect peaceful retreat in the Lake District, boasting wonderful views over Grizedale Forest and the Coniston mountain range.
